title: DESIGN.md | The One File AI Needs to Match Your UI
design.md Is The New Design System Primitive
"how are your designs so good?" spacing.
key_takeaways: Spacing is named as the single biggest differentiator between amateur and polished UI work.
Bad spacing degrades otherwise competent designs more than most designers realize.
Treat spacing obsessively rather than as an afterthought; the payoff is immediate and visible.

title: just master typography and you can make anything look good
key_takeaways: Typography mastery is presented as a general-purpose lever: it lifts the quality of any design.
Framed as a follow-up to the author's spacing post, pairing type and spacing as the two core fundamentals.
Positions fundamentals over decoration as the route to designs that read as good.

title: The visual dictionary of UI
key_takeaways: Announces a reference tool that maps informal descriptions of UI elements to their correct formal names.
Each lookup also returns the corresponding API symbol for the component.
Output includes a paste-ready prompt aimed at coding agents, bridging design vocabulary and AI implementation.
Targets the common failure where designers and developers cannot name the component they want.
